$comment: How many MAJOR versions ahead of the npm packages the published Rust crates run. scripts/sync-versions.js applies it when writing the Rust manifests; scripts/check-rust-major-offset.mjs fails CI when the manifests and this file disagree. See scripts/lib/rust-major-offset.mjs for why an offset and not an absolute override, and docs/contributing/release.md for how to raise it. A non-zero offset MUST carry `reason` and `refs`.
reason: Rust-only break #2: carrying the representation-item id on GPU-instanced occurrences (#2985) adds a public field to four structs that are exhaustively constructible through the public API, so any downstream struct literal stops compiling. Measured with cargo-semver-checks against the published 7.1.1, --release-type minor: ifc-lite-geometry 196 checks, 195 pass, 1 fail, 58 skip (InstanceMeshRef::item_id, DecodedInstance::item_id); ifc-lite-processing the same verdict (InstanceRecord::geometry_item_id, RawInstanceOccurrence::geometry_item_id). Both report "semver requires new major version: 1 major and 0 minor checks failed" on constructible_struct_adds_field. None of the four is #[non_exhaustive], and adding that attribute would itself be breaking, so the feature cannot ship without a major. The npm packages carry only a minor, and a changeset written about the TypeScript API cannot express a Rust break. The previous offset of 1 is retained in history: this raises it rather than replacing it, because the offset is cumulative against the npm major. Rust-only break #2 also covers `ifc-lite-export`, which acquired four constructible-struct fields in the same unpublished cycle: `StepStats.refused_refs`, `MergedOptions.drop_empty_containers`, `MergedStats.dropped_container_count` and `GltfStats.unverified_instance_groups` (#3666). Re-measured with cargo-semver-checks 0.50.0 against the published 7.1.1, --release-type minor: 196 checks, 195 pass, 1 fail, 58 skip, the one failure being constructible_struct_adds_field naming all four, and "semver requires new major version". None of the four structs is #[non_exhaustive] and the repo's precedent for RESULT/stats structs is a plain struct (only the OPTIONS structs `GltfOptions` and `ModelOptions` carry the attribute), so adding it would itself be a break rather than the way this is recorded. The offset is NOT raised again: it went to 2 on 2026-08-30, after the last publish tag, so the 8.x major it implies is still pending and these fields ride it. This entry is the record of what else that major covers.
